HEADER_INDEX.TITLE: Agents AI
HEADER_INDEX.DESCRIPTION: Select one of your AI agents to modify its properties or capabilities according to your business needs.

ADD.NAME: Add new agent
ADD.DESCRIPTION: Enter your new AI agent's details. This data will define the agent's behavior, so customize it to your business's needs.

DESCRIPTION.LABEL: Agent Description
DESCRIPTION.PLACEHOLDER: Enter a description of the agent

HEADER_CAPABILITIES.TITLE: Capabilities
HEADER_CAPABILITIES.DESCRIPTION_A: In this section, you can configure how you want your AI agent to help you respond to messages, provide information, or perform tasks automatically.
HEADER_CAPABILITIES.DESCRIPTION_B: Customize its behavior, response tone, and the features you want to enable. No technical knowledge is needed—just choose what works best for your business and let the agent do the rest.

RAG.NAME: Source of knowledge
RAG.DESCRIPTION: Add, view, edit, or delete additional information about your business that the AI agent will use in its responses.

FORM.NAME: Add information to the AI agent
FORM.DESCRIPTION: Add PDF files with information about your business. These documents will help train the agent so its responses are better focused on the topics you provide.
FORM.PLACEHOLDER_ID: Enter a unique name as an identifier
FORM.PLACEHOLDER_DESCRIPTION: Enter a brief description of the information

CALENDAR.NAME: Manage your calendar
CALENDAR.DESCRIPTION: Sync your account and authorize access to your calendar. This will allow the agent to view, edit, and add events on your behalf.

IMPORT.NAME: Import your catalog from a CSV file
IMPORT.DESCRIPTION_A: Import your products via an Excel file with a CSV extension. Use the
IMPORT.DESCRIPTION_B: to add your products with the necessary data. Please note that the first three columns are required fields.

UPLOAD.SUCCESS: Your catalog has been updated successfully.
UPLOAD.ERROR: There was an error loading the catalog
UPLOAD.CONTENT_ERROR: The content is not in the required format

TABLE_ERROR.HEADER: Incorrect names were detected in some of your column headers
TABLE_ERROR.HEADER_INCOMPLETE: Your csv file does not have all the necessary columns

CONFIGURATION.NAME: Agent configuration
CONFIGURATION.DESCRIPTION: This section allows you to configure the main information for an AI agent, including its name, description, and other relevant parameters. Here you can define the information that will identify the agent and customize its behavior according to the system's needs.

DESCRIPTION.LABEL: Agent Description
DESCRIPTION.PLACEHOLDER: Enter a description of the agent

SNAPSHOT.NAME: Agent Test
SNAPSHOT.DESCRIPTION: Test your agent's capabilities in a simulated conversation, providing a more realistic experience for your customers.

CREATE.UNIQUE_ERROR: A file with the same identifier already exists
CREATE.ERROR: There was an error uploading the files

UPDATE.ERROR: There was an error modifying the description

DELETE.ERROR: There was an error deleting the file from the knowledge source

SNAPSHOT.TITLE: Agent Test
SNAPSHOT.SUBTITLE: Configure and test your chatbot with personalized parameters.
SNAPSHOT.USER_PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER: Type the interaction prompt to start the test…
SNAPSHOT.BULLET_CONFIGURE: Write the base prompt that will guide all the agent’s responses.
SNAPSHOT.BULLET_TRY: Include business context, goals, and target audience.
SNAPSHOT.BULLET_MONITOR: Define tone, language, and boundaries (what to say and what not to say).
SNAPSHOT.BULLET_TUNE: Save the changes to apply the new prompt.
SNAPSHOT.BUTTON_SET_CONFIG_HINT: Save this prompt as the agent’s default configuration
SNAPSHOT.CHAT_PLACEHOLDER: Write a message and press Enter…
SNAPSHOT.CHAT_EMPTY: Start the test to see messages here.
